7578.title: Recover mobile delivery after cross-project batch rejection
7578.rootCauseOneLine: The sender mixes subscriptions into size-only batches and treats a cross-project request rejection as terminal instead of retrying smaller batches.

prReviews.topFinding: Partitions rejected requests from relay-provided project groups; not present on the trusted main commit. Its code was not executed.

7578.proposedFix: On the specific cross-project request error, recursively split a rejected batch in half until accepted or reduced to one subscription, preserving ticket accounting and removal behavior.
7578.caveats: Reproduced through the real plugin using a deterministic Expo transport substitute in two clean trusted checkouts. No real Expo credentials, mobile hardware, OS notification delivery, or production server were used. The complete regression patch is embedded in the report.
